symbol.description: Dependency export or member affected, e.g. 'Server.handleProtocols', 'parse_authorization_header'

change.description: What changed: removed, renamed to X, return type A->B, now throws on Y, default changed

versions.description: Version range where the change landed if known, e.g. '>=8.0.0'

ref.description: sha, version string, advisory id, or PR number

quote.description: The line from the source that states the change
